[tool.pytest.ini_options]
addopts = "--cov={{package_name}} --cov-report=term-missing --cov-report=xml --cov-fail-under={{threshold}}"
testpaths = ["tests"]

[tool.coverage.run]
branch = true
source = ["{{package_name}}"]

[tool.coverage.report]
exclude_lines = [
  "pragma: no cover",
  "raise NotImplementedError",
  "if __name__ == .__main__.:",
]
